name: web_search_pagination
description: Search + pagination + URL state — common SaaS pattern. Catches generators that miss URL/back-button behaviour or empty-state UX.

ticket.summary: Search results page supports pagination and deep-linking
ticket.description: On /search, entering a query and pressing Enter shows up to 20 results per page. Below the results is a pager: Previous, page numbers, Next. The URL updates to /search?q=...&page=N when the user paginates. Hitting the browser Back button returns to the previous page of results. If no results are found, an empty-state illustration and 'No results for X — try a different query' is shown.
acceptance_criteria: Given a query with 47 matching results, when the user lands on /search?q=foo, then 20 results are shown and the pager lists pages 1-3.
Given the user is on page 1, when they click Next, then page 2 results render and the URL updates to ?q=foo&page=2.
Given the user navigated 1 → 2 → 3, when they press the browser Back button, then page 2 is restored.
Given a query with zero matches, when the user submits, then the empty-state component and 'No results for foo' is shown.
Given a slow network (3G throttle), when the user paginates, then a loading skeleton appears within 200ms.

expected_scenarios: browser back: restores previous page state
